```{r}
library(alarmdata)
library(redist)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggredist)
library(patchwork)
library(sf)
```



```{r}
#LOAD data
map_NY <- alarm_50state_map('NY')
map_NY <- map_NY |>
  filter(!cd_2020 %in% c(10, 11)) |>
  mutate(vote_tot = nrv + ndv)

map_NY2 <- redist_map(map_NY, existing_plan = cd_2020, pop_tol = 0.01, total_pop = pop, adj = map_NY$adj)

NY_plans <- readRDS("C:/Users/Ryan dinham/OneDrive/school/data society/NY_Legal.rds")
```






```{r}
NY_plans <- NY_plans |> 
mutate(dem_district = dem_vote > 0.55)


dem_counts <- NY_plans |>
  group_by(draw) |>
  summarise(
    mean_comp       = mean(comp,        na.rm = TRUE),
    min_comp        = min(comp,         na.rm = TRUE),  # worst district
    max_pop_dev     = max(abs(pop_dev), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_dem_districts = sum(dem_district),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(n_dem_districts))

print(dem_counts)
```








```{r}
best_plans <- dem_counts |>
  filter(n_dem_districts %in% c(16, 17))
```




```{r}

#ranks redistricts


best_plans <- best_plans |>
  mutate(
    score_comp  = .8 * mean_comp + 0.2 * min_comp,
    score_dev   = 1 - (max_pop_dev / 0.01),
    total_score = (0.8 * score_comp) + (0.2 * score_dev)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(total_score)) |>
  mutate(rank = row_number())

best <- best_plans |>
  filter(rank == 2) |>
  pull(draw) |>
  as.character()

print(best_plans |> select(rank, draw, score_comp, score_dev, total_score))
    

best <- best_plans |>
  filter(rank == 1) |>
  pull(draw) |>
  as.character()


print(best_plans |> select(rank, draw, score_comp, score_dev, total_score))
```



```{r}
#map dem 
temp <- get_plans_matrix(NY_plans)


order_draw  <- unique(NY_plans$draw)
best_draw    <- which(order_draw == best)
best_assign <- temp[, best_draw]          

district_sf <- map_NY2 |>
  mutate(district = best_assign) |>
  group_by(district) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop")



redist.plot.plans(NY_plans,
                  draws = best,
                  shp   = map_NY2,
                  qty   = dem_vote) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low      = "#B2182B",   # deep Republican red
    mid      = "#F7F7F7",   # clean neutral white
    high     = "#2166AC",   # strong Democratic blue
    midpoint = 0.50,
    limits   = c(0.30, 0.70),
    oob      = scales::squish) +
      geom_sf(data        = district_sf,
          fill        = NA,
          color       = "black",      # white borders pop better than black
          linewidth   = .8,
          inherit.aes = FALSE)
```






```{r}
my_cutpoints <- c(0, .35, .45, .49, .5, .51, .55, .65, 1.00)
my_labels    <- c("R+15 or more", "R+5 to R+15", "R+1 to R+5", "R+0 to R+1",
                  "D+0 to D+1",  "D+1 to D+5",  "D+5 to D+15","D+15 or more")
my_colors    <- c("#b2182b","#d6604d","#f4a582","#fddbc7",
                  "#e8f4f8","#92c5de","#4393c3","#174778")

redblue <- NY_plans |>
    mutate(margin = factor(
        cut(dem_vote, breaks = my_cutpoints, labels = my_labels),
        levels = my_labels))




temp <- get_plans_matrix(NY_plans)


all_draws   <- unique(NY_plans$draw)
best_col    <- which(all_draws == best)
best_assign <- temp[, best_col]          




district_sf <- map_NY2 |>
  mutate(district = best_assign) |>
  group_by(district) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop")



redist.plot.plans(redblue,
                  draws = best,
                  shp   = map_NY2,
                  qty   = margin) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = setNames(my_colors, my_labels),
    drop   = FALSE                          
  ) +
  geom_sf(data        = district_sf,
          fill        = NA,
          color       = "black",
          linewidth   = 0.4,
          inherit.aes = FALSE)

```

```{r}
#histogram of dem leaning district counts
dem_counts|>
  ggplot(aes(x = n_dem_districts)) +
  geom_histogram()

dem_counts |>
  summarise(
    min    = min(n_dem_districts),
    q1     = quantile(n_dem_districts, 0.25),
    median = median(n_dem_districts),
    mean   = mean(n_dem_districts),
    q3     = quantile(n_dem_districts, 0.75),
    max    = max(n_dem_districts),
    iqr    = IQR(n_dem_districts),
    sd     = sd(n_dem_districts)
  )
```
